Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 3580acc051e8b7f8ad5fba1ce8827891111f6ba9 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.
